BrochureContent.Content:
An opportunity to acquire up to 9 acres of quality land in the scenic rural setting of Curraghdobbin, Carrick-on-Suir, Co. Tipperary. Situated along a public road with excellent frontage and visibility, this attractive parcel offers purchasers the chance to secure a residential site in a peaceful countryside location while remaining within convenient reach of a number of major towns and cities.

The land enjoys an appealing setting surrounded by open countryside and mature agricultural landscapes, creating an attractive environment for those seeking a rural lifestyle. The generous road frontage provides easy access and enhances the overall appeal of the holding.

Flexibility is a key feature of this offering, with the vendor willing to consider the sale of a smaller acreage if required. This may appeal to a range of purchasers seeking a residential site with additional land for personal use and enjoyment.

Despite its tranquil setting, the property remains well connected. Carrick-on-Suir is located approximately 8 km away, while Clonmel is approximately 18 km distant. Kilkenny City and Waterford City are each within approximately 35 km, providing access to a wide range of services, employment opportunities, shopping, education, and leisure amenities.

Properties offering a combination of rural surroundings, accessibility, and flexible acreage are increasingly difficult to find, making this an opportunity worthy of consideration.

Scenic countryside setting in a sought-after rural location

Attractive parcel with extensive road frontage

Excellent visibility from the public road

Flexible purchase options with smaller acreage considered

Peaceful setting surrounded by open farmland

Convenient access to Carrick-on-Suir and Clonmel

Accessible to both Kilkenny City and Waterford City

Opportunity to enjoy rural living while remaining connected to urban centres

Well-positioned holding with straightforward road access
